items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: They both made the agreement with me. They were both present during the discussion, the agreement, I shook hands with both of them.

ctx.x: Did he ever have that kind of pattern before?

They both made the agreement with me. They were both present during the discussion, the agreement, I shook hands with both of them. Two months of full salary and half until it's paid back. I wasn't going to take more than three weeks of being screwed like that.
What was the time; was that the moment of--was that halfway through "Over the Rainbow" to put a time on it? Is that why "Over the Rainbow" was incomplete?
